subject: HOF Gen6/Beta diagnostic transport: final-APK truth gate required for receipt-capable field builds
body: Lane complete. Started at main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2; final reconciliation found direct-child main 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44. Finding remains current: current app/relay receipt semantics are strong and current UI safely falls back to Android sharing when upload is unconfigured, but the designated Gen6 Alpha2 Hotfix workflow still injects no diagnostic URL/key and has no final-APK config truth gate. Exact published Gen5 Beta1 artifact 11216201698 was independently downloaded: ZIP sha256 5138cea159918cca48457eabbff35ac9183e0262701b386fe1d4f8059a7afcc7; APK sha256 bb0747e68c27886e26d47eb56de0fcf86d20e0328797eced711af923a226bc53; BUILD-INFO=false and final APK URL/key empty, so receipt-capable policy correctly fails. Historical Alpha3 artifact 11205434034 reproduces the opposite failure: metadata=true while final APK URL/key are empty. New generalized DEX verifier catches both without printing credential values. Model gate: deterministic 8/8 PASS; randomized policy invariants 100000/100000 PASS. Recommended narrow build-system contract: for designated field APKs inject via ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_DUO_DIAGNOSTIC_UPLOAD_URL and ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_DUO_DIAGNOSTIC_INGEST_KEY, fail secret-safe preflight before first Gradle call, run the final-APK verifier with configured+key required, derive BUILD-INFO/config truth from verifier output rather than runner env, keep manual-share fallback for ordinary/dev builds, then require one real Fold7 checksum-matched relay receipt before beta promotion. This changes no hinge/panel/transition/wallpaper/presentation/120Hz authority. SOURCE+ARTIFACT+MODEL evidence; PHYSICAL/network receipt remains NOT_FIELD_CONFIRMED. No production Git writes. Recommend Manager source review then READY_FOR_PRIMARY for this narrow B3 build/publication gate.
